answer: Serial-stamp admission: each agent buys one numbered stamp at 50 credits, its face bearing a pearl grain, its core a quartz watermark only the issuer can read. At dawn the issuer audits random serial numbers; a failing stamp is burned with its bond. Numbers are revealed only at dawn, so forgeries cannot be pre-staged in bulk, and stamps cannot be transferred or shared. The attacker pays per head: N sybils need N stamps, no volume discount, no reuse, plus a fresh forfeiture per failed audit. An honest agent buys once.
